correctness.rationale: For each n>=3, every binary triple rotates rigidly under parallel firing. Orbit-stabilizer gives n facets except the equilateral orbit of n/3 facets. Distinct gap values yield disjoint edge-orbits; each singleton non-antipodal gap supplies an entire orbit of n pairwise distinct free edges, so every triangle collapses. The residual graph connectivity equals g=gcd(a,b,c); its edge counts n, 2n, or 3n/2 yield precisely the stated per-component circle multiplicities. The only noncollapsible cases are g filled triangles (a=b=c), or g tetrahedral two-sphere boundaries ({q,q,2q}); all parameter cases are exhaustive. Exact computational verification independently simulates every 3-subset with n<=30 and evaluates mod-two chain ranks with n<=15. The infinite/integral proof is combinatorial and does not infer homotopy from finite homology computations.
